compatibility: Do not replace kernel-api.v1.json or claim deployed OpenAPI; review against generated FastAPI OpenAPI before implementation.

EvidenceAnchor.note: Typed locator shape varies by kind; canonical coordinates, representation and parser provenance required.

FindingCandidate.note: Empty evidence anchors allowed only in candidate/quarantined state; confidence optional and non-authoritative.

VerificationResult.note: Independent statuses; semantic support is not inferred from quote match.

CoverageManifest.note: Projection of audited events; PROCESSED does not imply sufficient coverage.

PromotionRequest.note: Actor context must be trusted server-resolved; never accept client-supplied authority.
